cases.title: tools/list returns the catalog revision
then: _meta carries the revision; the permit records it

cases.title: A stale revision with a changed schema is rejected
cases.when: A call carries an old revision whose tool schema changed since
then: A stale-catalog error and toolsListChanged is signalled

cases.title: A stale revision for an unchanged tool succeeds
cases.when: A call carries an old revision whose tool did not change

cases.title: Each invocation is pinned to one package digest
cases.when: A rollout changes the digest while a task runs
then: The task completes on its admitted digest

cases.title: Canary cohorts are sticky per agent
cases.when: One agent calls repeatedly during a canary
then: Every call uses the same version

cases.title: mcpName grammar and default
cases.when: Tools without mcpName and with invalid characters

cases.title: llm-strict aliases are derived deterministically
cases.when: Names with dots, 80 characters, and two colliding after truncation
then: Long or colliding names are truncated with _ and 8 hex of SHA-256(toolId)
A remaining collision rejects enable naming the tools

cases.title: Calls accept the name or the alias
cases.when: A tool is called by mcpName and by alias
then: Both resolve to the same toolId before policy
